blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Filipino pole vault star EJ Obiena believes he is in a better position to make another run at the Olympics as he eyes competing in the 2028 Los Angeles Games. Speaking at a Senate hearing Thursday, Obiena expressed confidence in his chances of making his third straight Olympics, citing his new training base in Athens, Greece, and plans to make adjustments to his training. “For the future, I think I’m in a much better place,” Obiena said. “I’ve recently moved to Athens, I train now with the world No. 2 [Emmanouil Karalis].
